8036277289140.description: Citrus Burst is a fruity floral fragrance mist that blends bright citrus with soft florals for a fresh, uplifting everyday scent. 8036277190836.description: CORAL is an eau de parfum that blends citrus and aquatic freshness with a floral heart for a bright, modern scent. Rose, jasmine, and lily create a romantic core, while woody musk adds warm depth for a balanced finish.

8036276764852.title: Corsica
8036276764852.description: Corsica is a vibrant fresh citrus fragrance for men inspired by the Mediterranean island's sun-kissed landscapes. A complex bouquet of Lime, Orange, Bergamot, Grapefruit, Mandarin, and Petitgrain opens with bright, effervescent energy, warmed by Black Pepper, Cardamom, and Peppermint. A floral heart of Jasmine, Muguet, and Neroli adds elegance, while a deep base of Sandalwood, Amber, Patchouli, and Musk creates a rich, lasting finish. Available in 100ml.

8036276666548.title: Cypress
8036276666548.description: Cypress is a sophisticated citrus woody fragrance for men with a distinctly European character. Italian Bergamot, Sicilian Lemon, Italian Orange, and Cassis open with a vibrant, sun-drenched freshness. A complex heart of Elemi, Black Pepper, White Jasmine, and Muguet adds spiced floral depth, while a base of Cedarwood, Patchouli, Amber, Leather, Moss, and Tobacco delivers a rich, commanding finish. Available in 100ml.

8036276895924.title: Dale
8036276895924.description: Dale is a warm woody oriental fragrance for men with timeless, sophisticated appeal. Apple, Lemon, Bergamot, and Orange Blossom open with a bright, uplifting freshness, leading into a heart of Rose, Teakwood, and Patchouli that adds richness and depth. A smooth base of Vanilla and Musk wraps the scent in a warm, sensual finish that lingers beautifully. Available in 100ml.

8036277026996.title: Gardenia

8036276699316.title: Majorca
8036276699316.description: Majorca is a fresh citrus marine fragrance for men evoking the breezy coastlines of the Mediterranean. Apple, Bergamot, Cardamom, Grapefruit, and Lemon Spike open with a crisp, invigorating burst, while a heart of Aqueous, Jasmine, Lily of the Valley, Marine, and Patchouli adds a cool, floral depth. A base of Moss, Musk, Sandalwood, and Vetiver creates a clean, earthy finish that lasts. Available in 100ml.

8036276961460.title: Meadow
8036276961460.description: MEADOW is a fresh, floral eau de parfum that blends uplifting lily, rose, and jasmine with vibrant citrus notes. Bergamot, lemon, and grapefruit add brightness, while sandalwood and musk create a warm, powdery finish for a balanced, long-lasting scent. Ideal for everyday wear and special occasions in spring and summer.

8050142707892.title: Mini Boston Bag – Black
8050142707892.description:

8050142576820.title: Mini Boston Bag – Coffee
8050142576820.description:

8036276568244.title: Mirage
8036276568244.description: Mirage Eau de Parfum combines a rich leather and woody profile with a sophisticated blend of saffron, black pepper, and olibanum for a memorable impression. Smoke fusion, rose damask, suede, amber, and oud add depth and warmth, making it ideal for formal and special occasions in the cooler seasons.

8036276633780.title: Oasis
8036276633780.description: OASIS is a leather oriental Eau de Parfum that blends fruity, floral, and woody notes for a sophisticated, modern aroma. Passion fruit, Turkish rose, and saffron open the fragrance, leading into a rich heart of agarwood, patchouli, and benzoin with a warm base of leather, amber, labdanum, and vanilla for lasting depth.

8036276994228.title: Orchard
8036276994228.description: Orchard is a floral, fruity eau de parfum that blends bright jasmine and red fruits with warm ambery, musky undertones. Lily of the valley, magnolia, and rose add elegant depth, while raspberry in the base leaves a soft, lasting trail suited to both everyday wear and special occasions.

8036277485748.title: Tropical Tease
8036277485748.description: Tropical Tease is a fruity floral body mist with a vibrant blend of grapefruit, rose, and white florals for a refreshing, elegant aroma. Muguet, jasmine, hyacinth, and iris add depth, while musk, woody, amber, and vanilla base notes create a warm, long-lasting finish.

8036277092532.title: Valencia
8036277092532.description: VALENCIA is a floral and fruity eau de parfum that blends bright citrus and juicy fruits with a soft, powdery base. Top notes of bergamot, aquatic accords, peach, apple, and lime open into a heart of jasmine, rose, neroli, freesia, muguet, and carnation, resting on warm vanilla, amber, sandalwood, and patchouli for lasting depth.

8036276830388.title: Whisler
8036276830388.description: Whisler is a clean, effortless fresh marine fragrance for men. An invigorating burst of fresh top notes opens the scent, while a cool aquatic marine heart adds depth and character. A soft musky base lingers beautifully for a light, lasting finish. Available in 100ml.
